evidence.dataset: Ghoke and colleagues, Reactivation dynamics of the Kuwari landslide, DOI 10.1007/s44288-026-00717-w
evidence.acquisition_date: optical and Sentinel-1 analysis from 2013 through 2025; article published 2026-09-05
evidence.spatial_coverage: Kuwari landslide on the Shambhu River, Kapkot, Bageshwar. The article states a landslide extent near 30.084–30.087 N and 79.79–79.80 E.
evidence.resolution_or_posting: Resourcesat-2/2A LISS-IV, three Sentinel-2 scenes, one Cartosat-3 scene, and Sentinel-1 SBAS; CartoDEM 10 m and SRTM 30 m are cited as model inputs
evidence.processing_level: published interpretation and a HEC-RAS scenario, not a RIVET measurement
evidence.overlaps_candidate_region: historical overlap with the same valley; not a pixel match to the Mission 006 crops
evidence.overlaps_acquisition_dates: no; the optical series ends in 2025 and does not include 2026-09-06 or 2026-09-30
evidence.limitations: Lake lengths reported in that paper are prior results. They are not an area for these candidate pixels and were not used to choose thresholds.

evidence.provider: Journal of the Geological Society of India
evidence.dataset: Bisht and colleagues, Kuwari Lake, 2022, DOI 10.1007/s12594-022-1927-3
evidence.resolution_or_posting: short geological communication; no new raster was retrieved
evidence.limitations: It cannot confirm or reject a September 2026 candidate pixel.

evidence.provider: South Asia Network on Dams, Rivers and People
evidence.overlaps_candidate_region: the coordinate is the study point already used for catalogue selection; it is not a surveyed patch corner
evidence.limitations: A secondary article is not independent pixel evidence.

evidence.acquisition_date: a scene-level query for 2026-09-06 and 2026-09-30 was not run
evidence.spatial_coverage: global 110 km tiles; the tile covering the study point was not confirmed in this mission
evidence.resolution_or_posting: 10 m visible and near-infrared bands, 20 m and 60 m for other bands
evidence.processing_level: L2A surface reflectance when a scene is retrieved
evidence.overlaps_acquisition_dates: unknown; global acquisition plans include September 2026, which does not prove a cloud-free scene over Kuwari
evidence.limitations: One L2A tile is commonly several hundred megabytes to about a gigabyte. It was not downloaded. No tile identifier is claimed.

evidence.acquisition_date: a path/row and scene query for the two NISAR dates was not run
evidence.spatial_coverage: WRS-2 scene; the path and row for 79.81 E, 30.09 N were not resolved here
evidence.limitations: A 30 m pixel is coarser than the 10 m GCOV posting. No scene was downloaded.

evidence.dataset: GLO-30 Public digital surface model, 2021 release
evidence.acquisition_date: static composite; not an observation on 2026-09-06 or 2026-09-30
evidence.spatial_coverage: global where the public 30 m tiles have been released; India tile release was not checked file by file
evidence.processing_level: DSM, including vegetation and structures where present
evidence.overlaps_candidate_region: a 30 m crop of the diagnostic window would be a few hundred pixels on a side, on the order of a few megabytes, and was not downloaded
evidence.overlaps_acquisition_dates: no; a DEM is not dated to the NISAR acquisitions
evidence.limitations: A DSM can support a later shadow and layover test. It does not by itself identify water, and it was not used to edit the candidate counts.
